source_note: Official MSHSAA 2026-27 boys and girls basketball class & district assignments (released 2026-11-20). Basketball only so far; add the other sports' 2026-27 blocks before schools.json rolls to 2026-27. One entry per school: co-op hosts carry the co-op's class (status 'coop', 'team' = full co-op name), and each partner school gets the same class (status 'coop_partner'). 'enrollment' is filled only for single public schools, so class enrollment ranges aren't skewed by combined co-op or private-school (multiplier) enrollments.
